$comment: Accepted decision records in clpr-spec/ADR, one row per file; check-data.mjs fails when a file upstream has no row. summary is the general page's one-sentence reading, detail the developer page's (may carry inline <code>).

adrs.title: CLPR ChannelContext Verifier Interface
adrs.summary: Verifiers are now told which channel they are checking, through a small fixed record called the "channel context", because identity should not live in the trust anchor, which changes over time, and some verifiers could not find the right data without it.
adrs.detail: Add an immutable ChannelContext (channel id, peer service address) to the verifier interface, separate from the rotating trust anchor, so EVM/QBFT verifiers can derive storage slots and provenance cannot be misattributed.

adrs.title: CLPR Endpoint Manifests
adrs.summary: The endpoint manifest (each ledger's on-chain list of endpoint addresses) moved out of the message queue and into proven on-chain state, because delivering the new addresses through a queue that needs the old addresses to deliver anything was a deadlock.
adrs.detail: Move endpoint lists out of ConfigUpdate into a proven, versioned on-ledger manifest refreshed through bundle payloads, fixing the complete-turnover deadlock; two-step admission with bond on permissionless ledgers.

adrs.title: CLPR Endpoint Sync Streaming Protocol and mTLS Root-of-Trust Model
adrs.summary: Endpoints now talk over a two-way stream rather than a single request, because the old shape sent every message twice in steady state. The same record set the encryption model: a long-lived certificate on chain and a short-lived one per process.
adrs.detail: Replace the unary sync RPC with a bidirectional-streaming request/response cycle that eliminates systematic duplicate sends; adopt a P-384 root CA / Ed25519 leaf mTLS model.

adrs.title: Restructuring and Renaming ClprQueueMetadata to a State Proven ChannelSyncData
adrs.summary: The part of a channel's record that gets a sealed proof was cut down to the three fields the other side actually needs, and a batch (bundle) was allowed to carry part of a backlog rather than all of it, so a very full outbound queue can still drain.
adrs.detail: Rename ClprQueueMetadata to a minimal, separately provable ChannelSyncData; allow bundles to carry a proper prefix of the backlog.

adrs.title: Removing Message Redaction
adrs.summary: A feature for redacting messages after the fact was removed, because a redacted and an unredacted message hashed to the same running hash, so anyone submitting a bundle could flip one for the other without detection.
adrs.detail: Remove message redaction: redacted and unredacted encodings were hash-equivalent, so any permissionless submitter could flip them undetected. Simplifies the running hash.
